_comment_finding: Finding #04: style-src 'unsafe-inline' Across All CSP Policies
_comment_what_was_wrong: The application allowed style-src 'unsafe-inline' across all global and route-level headers. This exposes the application to CSS injection attacks, such as token exfiltration via CSS attribute selectors and unauthorized UI redress / phishing overlays.
_comment_what_this_fix_does: Replaces style-src 'unsafe-inline' with nonce-based style execution or cryptographic SHA-256 hashes of critical inline stylesheet snippets, and provides configuration guidance for extracting remaining dynamic inline style tags into external CSS bundles.

headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'nonce-{{DYNAMIC_NONCE}}' 'strict-dynamic'; style-src 'self' 'nonce-{{DYNAMIC_NONCE}}' https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src 'self' https://fonts.gstatic.com data:; connect-src 'self' https://api.worldmonitor.app; img-src 'self' data: blob:; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none';
